abstract: AIM: To identify clinical prognostic factors for survival of patients with squamous cell carcinoma (SqCC) arising from mature cystic teratoma (MCT) of the ovary with review of the published reports. METHODS: Clinical data of 55 patients with SqCC arising from MCT of the ovary who were reported in the Korean Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology and the Korean Journal of Gynecologic Oncology and Colposcopy between 1992 and 2006 were reviewed. Clinical factors were analyzed to identify their association with disease-free survival and overall survival (OS), which were evaluated using the Kaplan-Meier analysis with the log-rank test. Clinical prognostic factors were identified using Cox's proportional hazard analysis. RESULTS: Patients with disease confined within the ovary (n = 31) or ascites <500 mL (n = 15) had the benefit of a higher mean OS than those with advanced disease (n = 8) (116 vs 21 months, P = 0.004) and ascites > or =500 mL (n = 7) (106 vs 8 months, P = 0.005), respectively. Disease confined within the ovary and ascites <500 mL were good prognostic factors by univariate but not multivariate Cox's proportional hazard analyses (HR = 0.123 and 0.139, 95% confidence interval = 0.022-0.670 and 0.027-0.722, respectively). CONCLUSIONS: Disease confined within the ovary and a smaller amount of ascites may be good prognostic factors for the OS of patients with SqCC arising from MCT of the ovary.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（MCT）由来の扁平上皮癌（SqCC）患者の生存に関する臨床的予後因子を、文献レビューとあわせて同定すること。方法：1992年から2006年に韓国産婦人科学会誌および韓国婦人科腫瘍・コルポスコピー学会誌に報告された、卵巣MCT由来SqCC患者55例の臨床データを検討した。無病生存期間および全生存期間(全生存率)との関連を、Kaplan-Meier法とlog-rank検定で評価した。臨床予後因子はCox比例ハザード解析で同定した。結果：卵巣内に限局した病変（31例）の患者は進行病変（8例）の患者より（116対21か月、P=0.004）、腹水500mL未満（15例）の患者は腹水500mL以上（7例）の患者より（106対8か月、P=0.005）、平均全生存期間(全生存率)が長かった。卵巣内限局および腹水500mL未満は、単変量解析では良好な予後因子であったが、多変量Cox解析では有意ではなかった（HR=0.123および0.139、95%信頼区間=0.022-0.670および0.027-0.722）。結論：卵巣内限局病変と少量の腹水は、卵巣MCT由来SqCC患者の全生存期間(全生存率)にとって良好な予後因子となりうる可能性がある。
